headline: Session done — Presolana long run executed as prescribed, strong quality
summary:
Solid execution: 853m D+/859m D- over 2h15 (target 2h30/800-900m), icu load 137 against a planned 130, RPE 6/feel 1 (great). HR zone time matches the design — bulk of the run sat in Z2 (145-155, ~1470s) and Z3 (160-166, ~1930s) exactly where the two tempo climbs were meant to bite, with only 129s above 174bpm so no drift into unplanned high zones. Average cadence read 76 on the device but that's the Garmin run-cadence metric conflated with hiking, not the 174+ flats target — nothing in the file suggests a cadence problem worth flagging beyond that measurement mismatch. No ITB or knee signal reported, HRR was a strong 32bpm (175→143 in 60s), and stop-rule conditions (HRV<55, RHR>51) were never triggered — Saturday HRV 64, RHR 46, so you ran the full upgraded version as planned.</summary>
